meta.name: As Beautiful As You
meta.description: Ji Xing, a technical talent who works diligently in a technology company, resigned resolutely in order to realize her dream and embarked on the road of entrepreneurship. The team formed by Ji Xing and her younger brother was in jeopardy at the beginning of the business. Just when there was no hope, Ji Xing won the support of Han Ting, President of Dongyang Technology, with his unique insights. With Han Ting's investment, the startup Xingchen is finally on the right track. But Ji Xing "lost" her first boyfriend who she had been in love with for seven years. The difficulties of starting a business and the pain of breaking up with her love almost destroyed her. Fortunately, she has the close protection of the sister group.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ji Xing is juggling her hectic job, family pressure about marriage, and a sleepless night before heading to work. On her way, a chain of small accidents leads to an unexpected collision that reconnects her with Han Ting after years. Later, she is pulled into a company presentation where she unexpectedly performs well in front of him, reopening their past connection.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The story of Ji Xing and Han Ting's past unfolds, revealing how they once studied together and separated due to misunderstandings and missed messages. Han Ting returns to a powerful corporate position while dealing with internal family and board conflicts. Their lives begin overlapping again as professional boundaries blur with unresolved emotions.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ji Xing resolves a major hospital system failure using her technical expertise, earning recognition but also jealousy from colleagues. Her success leads to increased workload and unfair treatment from her superiors, who try to suppress her. Exhausted and frustrated, she finally chooses to resign and rethink her career path.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Ji Xing starts a new journey by launching a 3D printing startup with friends, rejecting Han Ting's corporate offer to maintain independence. The venture begins with enthusiasm but quickly runs into financial and operational struggles. Meanwhile, Han Ting continues to watch her progress closely, confident she will eventually face pressure to return.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Ji Xing and Han Ting clash directly when he offers investment under corporate conditions, which she firmly rejects. She insists on building something original rather than relying on his company's structure. Even after rejection, Han Ting continues quietly supporting her potential, believing in her long-term success.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Ji Xing's startup faces repeated failures, including failed investor meetings and internal struggles, pushing the team to the edge. During this time, she also gets entangled in awkward social and business encounters that complicate her emotional state. Despite setbacks, her team slowly becomes more resilient through shared hardship.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As financial pressure peaks, Ji Xing is forced to consider investment offers, including one from Han Ting's rival side. Torn between survival and independence, she struggles with whether to compromise her vision. Eventually, she edges toward strategic cooperation while still protecting her core ideals.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Ji Xing secures funding and begins stabilizing her company, but her personal life collapses when she breaks up with Shao Yichen. The emotional shock forces her to fully focus on work while shutting down her personal attachments. Han Ting remains a quiet support system as she rebuilds herself professionally.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In her most vulnerable phase, Ji Xing repeatedly crosses paths with Han Ting, leading to emotionally charged and confusing moments. A drunken incident exposes her suppressed grief and unresolved dependence on her past. Their relationship resets into a fragile balance between professional ambition, emotional healing, and unspoken feelings.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Han Ting and Ji Xing navigate subtle emotional tension as work, investment, and misunderstandings overlap in their relationship. Ji Xing struggles with guilt after professional conflicts make her feel she has crossed personal boundaries with Han Ting. Meanwhile, external pressures from family, business rivals, and startup challenges begin tightening around both of them.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Miscommunication deepens when Ji Xing tries to clarify her stance with Han Ting, but his cold responses leave her emotionally shaken. Han Ting privately worries about her reputation and silently continues protecting her while maintaining distance. As both face family expectations and corporate pressure, their connection becomes more complicated yet unavoidable.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: At a corporate gathering, Han Ting continues to subtly support Ji Xing despite rising jealousy and interference from rivals like Zeng Di. Ji Xing slowly realizes Han Ting's actions are consistently guiding her career forward, even when he appears distant. Meanwhile, other relationships around them begin evolving, creating a shifting emotional landscape.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: During the New Year period, Ji Xing is accidentally stranded while her family tries to surprise her. Han Ting finds her and ensures she is safe, revealing his constant concern for her well-being. The holiday softens emotional barriers between them as both spend time with family and reflect on their growing bond.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Ji Xing's startup gains momentum as the team expands and begins stabilizing operations with Han Ting's indirect support. Despite corporate competition and internal family conflicts, Ji Xing steps into leadership with growing confidence. Han Ting publicly acknowledges her growth, further strengthening her position in the industry.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Business challenges intensify as material shortages and corporate sabotage threaten Ji Xing's company progress. Han Ting and Ji Xing indirectly counter rival interference while maintaining professional boundaries. Ji Xing's problem-solving skills begin to solidify her reputation as a capable entrepreneur.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Ji Xing and Han Ting continue to collaborate professionally while maintaining emotional restraint in their relationship. Workplace success grows as their project stabilizes and gains industry attention. However, personal feelings remain unresolved, quietly influencing every decision they make.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: At a business forum and public events, Han Ting repeatedly supports Ji Xing's visibility in the industry. Ji Xing gains confidence as her company begins standing alongside competitors. Their interactions become more public, subtly hinting at deeper emotional undercurrents.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: A series of near-misses and emotional coincidences bring Ji Xing and Han Ting closer again during work and travel. Past relationships and unresolved feelings surface as they confront lingering emotional ties. Despite awkwardness, their trust and dependence on each other continue to grow.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Ji Xing expands her professional journey internationally while Han Ting remains a steady presence in her career growth. Their time in Germany strengthens both emotional connection and mutual respect. The episode ends with their relationship evolving into a quieter but deeper understanding during shared moments of closeness.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Ji Xing slowly realizes her feelings for Han Ting as they grow closer during a business trip. Zeng Di tries to create misunderstandings between them, stirring jealousy. Despite tension, Han Ting openly rejects Zeng Di and reassures Ji Xing through his actions.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Ji Xing develops a new company direction while Han Ting quietly supports her vision from behind the scenes. Their bond deepens as they unknowingly align on the same strategic thinking. A subtle emotional pull grows between them despite interruptions from others.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Ji Xing escapes emotional confusion by returning home, while Han Ting struggles to understand her sudden distance. Misunderstandings spread as both hesitate to express their feelings directly. Ji Xing begins to miss Han Ting but still avoids contact.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: A corporate crisis and medical complications bring Ji Xing and Han Ting back into intense collaboration. Han Ting protects Ji Xing both professionally and emotionally despite his own health issues. Their trust strengthens as they face external accusations together.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Han Ting confesses his feelings and Ji Xing accepts, officially starting their relationship. They spend intimate, peaceful moments together while their personal and professional lives begin to merge. Meanwhile, external business conflicts begin to rise again.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: A major scandal threatens Han Ting and Ji Xing's companies, testing their unity. Ji Xing feels guilty while Han Ting takes control of the situation strategically. Together, they overcome the crisis and reaffirm their emotional connection.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Jealousy and misunderstandings surface as Ji Xing sees Han Ting with Zeng Di again. Han Ting reassures her by making their connection more transparent and secure. Their relationship strengthens through honest communication and vulnerability.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Internal company conflicts and sabotage attempts create stress for Ji Xing's leadership. Han Ting steps in decisively, exposing hidden manipulation behind the scenes. Their partnership deepens as they balance love and business challenges.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Emotional conflicts arise among multiple couples as secrets and expectations clash. Ji Xing and Han Ting attend a wedding where others face heartbreak and truth. Despite chaos around them, their relationship remains stable and committed.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Business rivalry escalates as Ji Xing's company faces pressure from larger competitors. Personal relationships strain as ambitions and truths about Han Ting's business ties surface. Ji Xing questions love and compatibility while standing at a major crossroads.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Han Ting and Ji Xing share a tense night together, but trust breaks when Ji Xing discovers Han Ting's hidden investment in Hanhai.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Corporate betrayal surfaces as Han Ting exposes Han Yuan's collusion with external forces, tightening control over the company's internal conflict.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Ji Xing formally resigns from Xingchen and leaves, ending her direct ties with Han Ting and the company.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Ji Xing adjusts to life abroad and studies under Professor Meng, gradually rebuilding her identity and ambitions.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Ji Xing returns to the company world, where Qin Li enters her life and develops feelings for her.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: External enemies intensify corporate attacks, leading to a dangerous kidnapping incident targeting Ji Xing.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Ji Xing and Han Ting reconcile in the hospital after the life-threatening rescue incident.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: The company faces another crisis involving false allegations and technical sabotage in the medical device market.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Ji Xing proves the company's credibility at a major press event while internal relationships among friends evolve.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Han Ting launches a major talent pool initiative that reshapes Dongyang's future and earns wide approval.
